text:
You need a Full-Stack Developer who can help integrate AI toolboxes into a mobile app while building a secure, scalable, and user-friendly product for a fast-moving legal tech startup.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, NLP, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, and pandas. I can help bridge AI capabilities with clean, maintainable application logic and support the development of intuitive interfaces and RESTful integrations.

I’m comfortable working independently, collaborating with designers and AI specialists, and learning new technologies quickly. If you need someone who can contribute to a mission-driven product with strong attention to code quality and practical AI integration, I’d be glad to help.
